verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows asynchronous batch scraping, crawls, and webhooks, but none of it documents scheduling jobs to run automatically at specific times. Async and batch jobs are one-off submissions, not a recurring schedule. The single passing mention of a "monitor check" in the webhook docs does not describe any scheduling or timing configuration, so it cannot be credited as this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times
